name: gitalike
description: Use any forge, keep your muscle memory. Re-skins GitHub and GitLab as each other, locally.

scripts.lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run package:chromium && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chromium: npm run build:chromium && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts/chromium --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts/firefox-signed --channel unlisted
